title: Migrate review-report plugin to contract v2
goal: Adopt result_contract:2 (verdict/disposition/reason on every exit path), fix the bare-extract lens parse defect, inject router budget guidance into lens prompts, and declare router budgets and cleanup sentinel in the manifest — all within the review-report plugin boundary.

steps.description: Write (or confirm present) the failing SPEC assertions before touching implementation. The test file must contain SPEC-1 through SPEC-17 covering: manifest result_contract:2 and config.router block (SPEC-1); _rr_write_result helper writes conformant v2 result (SPEC-2); verdict=error/disposition=broken on missing state_file (SPEC-3) and missing out_json (SPEC-4); verdict=pass/disposition=complete on normal completion (SPEC-5); _rr_budget_guidance injects TURN BUDGET into lens prompts (SPEC-6); _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok validates {score,findings} (SPEC-7); extract_first_json_object absent from lenses.sh and _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate present (SPEC-8); advisory report still written and returns 0 (SPEC-9); 11 independent LLM calls still made (SPEC-10); valid_verdicts:[] declared (SPEC-11); primary:true on first output (SPEC-12); provides.role and four events declared (SPEC-13); no active cleanup hook (SPEC-14); ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS read for scope_manifest (SPEC-15); disposition=exhausted when at least one lens returns non-zero rc (SPEC-16); no hardcoded state_dir paths for declared input filenames (SPEC-17). Run the suite and confirm each new SPEC fails for the stated reason at merge-base before proceeding.

Amend manifest.yaml to satisfy SPEC-1, SPEC-11, SPEC-12, SPEC-13, SPEC-14: (1) add `result_contract: 2` under `provides:` alongside `role: review_report`; (2) add `config.router:` block with `timeout_s: 300` and `max_turns: 25` (defaults matching T2 budget; template override still wins per manifest-router-budget.sh); (3) confirm `valid_verdicts: []` is present; (4) confirm `primary: true` on the `review_report` output (already declared); (5) confirm four provides.events are declared; (6) add `cleanup: ~` null sentinel under `hooks:` (absent and recorded per ADR-001 §2, satisfies #1829); (7) add `review_report_result` output entry with `path: ${artifact_dir}/review-report-result.json`, `type: review-report-result.json@2`, `required: true` (the v2 result sidecar). Confirm SPEC-1, SPEC-11, SPEC-12, SPEC-13, SPEC-14 now pass.

Update plugin.sh to satisfy SPEC-2 through SPEC-6, SPEC-15, SPEC-16, SPEC-17: (1) add `_rr_write_result <dir> <verdict> <disposition> <reason>` helper that writes `review-report-result.json` with result_contract:2 via jq+atomic_write (pattern from teardown/plugin.sh); (2) call it at every terminal exit path in review_report_run (missing state_file → verdict=error, disposition=broken) and _rr_run_inner (missing out_json → verdict=error, disposition=broken; normal completion → verdict=pass, disposition=complete; any lens failed → verdict=pass, disposition=exhausted); (3) add `_rr_budget_guidance <max_turns> <timeout_s>` that produces a TURN BUDGET block; (4) in _rr_run_inner resolve `_route_resolve_max_turns` and `_route_resolve_timeout` and pass the guidance string to `_rr_fanout_lenses`; (5) read scope_manifest from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS via `jq -r '.inputs.scope_manifest // empty'` when ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is set and readable; (6) source scripts/lib/llm-agent.sh before sourcing lib/lenses.sh (prerequisite for _llm_envelope_parse). Remove any hardcoded state_dir path concatenations for declared input filenames. Confirm SPEC-2 through SPEC-6, SPEC-15, SPEC-16, SPEC-17 pass.

Update lenses.sh to satisfy SPEC-7 and SPEC-8: (1) add `_rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok <json>` predicate that validates type==object and score:number and findings:array via jq -e (mirrors security-lens/plugin.sh:42); (2) in `_rr_parse_lens_out` replace the bare `extract_first_json_object` call with `_llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok "$raw_out" json _rr_lp_prose`; on empty json or jq failure emit `review_report.lens.unparseable` event and degrade to empty findings — identical visible-failure behaviour as before. Do NOT collapse onto the impact two-phase parser (ADR-060). Confirm SPEC-7 and SPEC-8 pass, and confirm SPEC-1 (lens fan-out) and SPEC-2 (dedup) still pass.

Run `npm test` with all changes committed so the mutation tier engages (CLAUDE.md requirement). Confirm: (1) all SPEC-1 through SPEC-17 are green; (2) legacy SPEC-1 through SPEC-15 (the pre-migration lens assertions) still pass; (3) `grep -n 'extract_first_json_object' plugins/agent/review-report/lib/lenses.sh` returns no match; (4) coverage floor not broken. Capture a before/after behavioral snapshot by diffing the SPEC-5 run's review-report.json (normal completion output) against the pre-migration output to satisfy the golden-diff acceptance criterion — write to tests/golden/review-report-pass.json if the directory exists, or assert equivalence inline in the SPEC-9 test. Record the red step in the PR body: which assertion, and how it failed before the fix.

notes: IMPLEMENTATION STATUS: As of branch zbuild/issue-1843-ci (commits ae0c64c5 and 60444768), all four source files are already fully migrated. manifest.yaml has result_contract:2, config.router:{timeout_s:300,max_turns:25}, cleanup:~, primary:true, valid_verdicts:[], four provides.events, and the review_report_result output. plugin.sh has _rr_write_result on all exit paths, _rr_budget_guidance calling _route_resolve_max_turns/_route_resolve_timeout, ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS reading, and exhausted disposition on lens failure. lenses.sh has _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok and uses _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate (extract_first_json_object is absent). tests/unit/review-report-plugin-test.sh has SPEC-1 through SPEC-17. The implement stage should verify each step is satisfied and run npm test to confirm green. PRIMARY OUTPUT ALREADY DECLARED: review_report output already has primary:true — no change needed. CLEANUP HOOK: cleanup:~ null sentinel is the correct form (ADR-001 §2); no review_report_cleanup function should exist. VALID_VERDICTS: [] is correct — plugin is advisory and emits no verdict through the pipeline verdict channel; the empty set is the claim, not a gap. GOLDEN DIFF: SPEC-9 and SPEC-10 verify behavioral equivalence for the passing-run path (advisory report written, 11 calls made, merge_readiness present); a separate tests/golden/ snapshot is a belt-and-suspenders item. The directory may not exist — treat step-5's golden file as conditional on the directory existing. COORDINATE WITH #1719: review-summary comment-count / verdict-marker gap is out of scope for this migration (no scope granted in the issue). INPUTS: name-matched inputs (id-only, no path/producer/from:) are satisfied — manifest uses id: only, and plugin.sh now reads scope_manifest from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS rather than constructing a path. The _rr_budget_guidance function accepts timeout_s as a second argument but the current TURN BUDGET block only references max_turns (not timeout_s) in its prose; this is acceptable — the value is sourced from the enforcing resolver (not hand-copied), satisfying ADR-063 §1. SCOPE: all files are under ./ (full repo scope); no scope-manifest prefix constraint excludes any path.
